changelog: Basketball rebuilt: smooth eye-level camera, real ball arc, clean exits and a fixed double-ticket bug.
Roller coaster: new onboard/chase/side ride cameras plus an in-game camera calibration tool (/coaster_cam).
Shooting range: the musket no longer disappears and reappears during a round.
Every interaction now shows once; arcade, punch machine and air hockey prizes and exits fixed.
Duck fishing: rod held properly in hand and real duck/pond textures restored in the sources.
